schema.raw_after: COM xyz, quaternion xyzw, linear velocity xyz, world angular velocity xyz
schema.contacts: Flat record: child (-1=parent), feature, depth, normal xyz, offset-from-A xyz. Normals B->A; child offsets relative to runtime child centre, parent offsets relative to body COM; fixed local-world axes.

schema.canonical: Raw/canonical position and linear velocity equal throughout; canonical quaternion retained separately.
